description: wizardingcode-mem for OpenCode. Persistent memory across sessions: what each session learns, the next one is told. One local binary, no daemon, no LLM in the loop; your plan is never spent on memory.

detail.description_zh: wizardingcode-mem 适用于 OpenCode。跨会话的持久记忆：每个会话学到的内容，下一个会话都会被告知。一个本地二进制文件，无守护进程，无循环中的大型语言模型；你的计划永远不会消耗记忆。
